gaps.explanation: Re-read p5 (printed p8, governmental funds statement, GAAP: General, Highway, Federal Grants, Nonmajor), p12 (printed p44, General Fund combining: General Fund + Veterans Aid), pp13-14 (printed pp47-48, nonmajor combining, 14 columns) and the Budget and Actual - Budgetary Basis schedules pp9-11, 15-30. Every fund column printed on pp5/12/13-14 has exactly one budget schedule in detail (General, Veterans Aid, Federal Grants, Highway and all 14 nonmajor funds); no column or schedule page is missing, no fund is in detail twice, and the detail lines add to each schedule's printed total (detail_totals). JSON statement total 179,283,717 = printed p5 Total revenues (no statement issue). The 23,808,624 excess is entirely the report's budgetary vs GAAP amounts. Per fund, GAAP (statement) - budgetary (schedule): General 131,090,317 (p5/p12) - 130,710,322 (p9) = 379,995; Highway 12,296,222 (p5) - 10,994,281 (p28) = 1,301,941; Federal Grants 14,230,499 (p5) - 39,210,186 (p11) = -24,979,687 (p11 budgetary 'Federal receipts' 35,802,829 vs GAAP Intergovernmental 12,231,013; p11 prints the reconciling 'Revenue accruals' (24,979,688)); nonmajor (pp13-14 vs pp15-27, 29): Visitors Improvement 2,040,648 - 1,978,730 = 61,918; County Visitors Promotion 2,040,649 - 1,978,730 = 61,919; County Rural Library 931,180 - 939,893 = -8,713; Keno 1,868,402 - 1,731,022 = 137,380; Economic Development 1,575 - 2,049 = -474; Mental Health 2,625,639 - 3,328,700 = -703,061 (the schedule p20 prints 'County aid' 1,013,160 as revenue; pp13 prints the same 1,013,160 as Mental Health Transfers in); Weed Control 278,732 - 291,430 = -12,698 (schedule 'Other receipts' 13,175 holds the p13 Sale of capital assets 12,700); Building 656,545 - 656,503 = 42; County Property Management 4,441,492 - 4,433,813 = 7,679 (schedule 'Other receipts' 5,200 = p14 Sale of capital assets 5,200); City Building Maintenance 312,607 - 312,606 = 1; Correctional Facility JPA 4,017,458 - 4,031,038 = -13,580; Law Enforcement Equipment 200,327 - 200,328 = -1; Bridge and Special Road 2,032,547 - 2,089,576 = -57,029 (schedule 'Other revenue' 18,675 = p14 Sale of capital assets 18,675); Sinking 218,878 - 203,134 = 15,744; nonmajor sum -510,873. 379,995 + 1,301,941 - 24,979,687 - 510,873 = -23,808,624 = gap. Nothing is counted twice; all detail lines are printed schedule lines. No fix.

Budgetary schedule totals (detail) 165,420,594 vs statement p5 Total expenditures 169,330,540 (= JSON). Per fund, budgetary - GAAP: General 112,524,975 (p10) + Veterans Aid 11,048 (p30) = 112,536,023 vs Total General 112,152,469 (p12) = +383,554; Federal Grants 8,037,509 (p11) vs 10,971,902 (p5) = -2,934,393 (p11 Expenditure accruals (3,262,706), encumbrances 478,506); Highway 17,644,850 (p28) vs 21,721,699 (p5) = -4,076,849; nonmajor 27,202,212 vs 24,484,470 (p14) = +2,717,742, of which Bridge and Special Road 9,124,434 (p27, 'Capitalized contracts' 6,549,029) vs 6,196,114 (p14, Capital outlays 3,930,805) = +2,928,320 and the other 13 funds -210,578 (County Visitors Promotion -15,730, Keno -9,600, Economic Development -22,952, Mental Health +3,049, Weed Control -8,318, Building -50,314, County Property Management -9,493, City Building Maintenance -2, Law Enforcement Equipment -7,289, Sinking -89,929; Visitors Improvement, Rural Library and Correctional Facility 0). 383,554 - 2,934,393 - 4,076,849 + 2,717,742 = -3,909,946 = gap. All funds present once; printed basis difference. No fix.

p5 Transfers in 21,998,965 = General 1,509,981 + Highway 7,783,916 + Nonmajor 12,705,068 (pp13-14: Mental Health 1,013,160, Weed Control 188,321, Building 11,966, County Property Management 11,532, Bridge & Special Road 6,146,484, Sinking 5,333,605). Detail transfers in 20,985,805 hold every one of these from the budget schedules except Mental Health 1,013,160: the Mental Health budget schedule (p20) prints no transfer row and carries that money as revenue 'County aid' 1,013,160, which is in detail. Adding a Mental Health Transfers In line would count the 1,013,160 twice. No fix.

p5 'Leases' 376,063 (JSON debt_proceeds) = General 225,871 + Federal Grants Fund 150,192; both are already in detail (pass 3 lines, p12 General Fund column and p5 Federal Grants column) = 376,063. The other 115,555 counted on the schedule side is the General Fund budget schedule line 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' 115,555 (p10), which is sale of property and belongs with JSON other_financing 153,454 (p5 'Proceeds from sale of capital assets' General 116,879 + Nonmajor 36,575). Debt_proceeds + other_financing = 529,517 vs detail 491,618: 1,324 is General budgetary 115,555 vs GAAP 116,879, and the nonmajor sale amounts 36,575 (Weed Control 12,700, County Property Management 5,200, Bridge & Special Road 18,675) are already inside the budget schedules' revenue lines (pp21, 23, 27), so adding them would double count. No fix.
